doc_title: Residential Circulators (Knowledge Base, Product FAQs)
locator: Q&A: Where can I get instructions for diagnostics on a 00 series pump?
cause_text: Pump is energized and turning but not moving water, so current looks normal
check_text: Clamp an amp meter on the pump and compare the reading with the nameplate amps
expected_obs: Reading close to nameplate amps while no water moves: pump running but not pumping
action: Look for why the pump is not moving water instead of assuming a seized motor
anchor: close to nameplate amps

doc_title: Residential Circulators (Knowledge Base, Product FAQs)
locator: Q&A: Where can I get instructions for diagnostics on a 00 series pump?
cause_text: Rotor locked or seized, so the motor draws locked-rotor current and moves no water
check_text: Clamp an amp meter on the pump and compare the reading with the nameplate amps
expected_obs: Amp draw about 1.5 times nameplate means locked rotor
action: Treat as a locked rotor and service or replace the rotating assembly
anchor: approx. 1 1/2 times nameplate amp

doc_title: Residential Circulators (Knowledge Base, Product FAQs)
